description: This file is a shell script library that provides functions and configurations for running and testing an HTTP server (such as Apache httpd) in a testing environment. It includes setup, teardown, and configuration functions for starting/stopping the server, handling SSL, modules, and various test scenarios related to HTTP server interactions.

methods.name: install_script
methods.description: Copies a script file from the test directory to the HTTPD root directory, preparing it for execution.

methods.name: prepare_httpd
methods.description: Sets up the HTTP server environment, including configurations, SSL certificates if enabled, and symbolic links. Copies necessary configuration and script files into the server root directory.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the HTTP server using the configured parameters and setup function. Also sets up cleanup procedures to stop the server after tests.

methods.name: enable_http2
methods.description: Adds HTTP/2 support to the server configuration and marks the prerequisite 'HTTP2'.

methods.name: enable_cgipassauth
methods.description: Configures the server to support the CGIPassAuth module if the server version is compatible.

methods.name: test_http_push_nonff
methods.description: Performs a test to verify that non-fast-forward Git pushes fail and produce the expected ref status and error messages, including force-with-lease scenario.

methods.name: set_askpass
methods.description: Sets up the askpass helper script to simulate user prompts for username and password during Git operations.

methods.name: expect_askpass
methods.description: Verifies that the askpass prompts match expected prompts based on the provided authentication type.

methods.name: strip_access_log
methods.description: Processes the server's access log to extract relevant request/response lines for comparison.

methods.name: check_access_log
methods.description: Compares the actual access log entries with expected entries to verify correct logging behavior.
